MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Ornamental Fish culture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
